description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git pathspec and diff functionalities. It contains test setup, expectations, and commands to verify correct behavior of Git diff operations with various pathspec patterns.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case with a description and script to execute, verifying expected behavior.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the raw output of git diff commands with expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty, indicating the test conditions are met.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files' contents for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Initializes or advances the test environment, often creating commits or repositories.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message in the current test repository.
